The `install-sh` file originated with the **X Consortium** and was originally **not copyrighted**. A copyright line was first added in Autoconf commit `4314bddf` in **July 1996**; before that, it was distributed without a copyright line.

Sources: [Autoconf 2.13 documentation](http://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/doc/autoconf2.13/autoconf.html), [bug-autoconf discussion](https://lists.nongnu.org/archive/html/bug-autoconf/2018-09/msg00009.html).
